purpose: Fish S2 Pro delivery cues, prepended to a character line as an inline [bracket] instruction according to the line's emotion label. An empty string means plain delivery. Edit freely: changing a cue re-records only the lines that use it.
decided_by: Owner's blind vote 2026-11-25 (pack 1db9fde846c619f385e75d41, 2 real lines per emotion, plain vs cued at the same seed). Rule: a cue stays on only if it won more comparisons than it lost. Cues that change texture (laugh, whisper, flat coldness) helped; intensity cues (angry, desperate, sarcastic, excited) over-acted.

desperate.result: plain won 1, tie 1 (owner: plain 'a lot better')

sarcastic.result: plain won 1, tie 1 (owner: plain 'a lot better')

frightened.result: split 1-1 (plain for Sunny, cue for Rain)

pleading.result: untested: no principal-cast line labelled pleading
